tradefeedr.get_fx_algo_pre_trade_forecast

Fetches pre-trade forecast for given parameters.

Available as lseg.data.tradefeedr.get_fx_algo_pre_trade_forecast.

get_fx_algo_pre_trade_forecast(
    universe: str | list[str],
    order_quantity_usd: float | int | list[float] | list[int],
    arrival_time: str | list[str],
    fields: str | list[str] | None = None,
    forecast_model: str | list[str] | None = None,
) -> DataFrame

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
universe str | list[str] Yes Instrument(s) to request.
order_quantity_usd float | int | list[float] | list[int] Yes List of order quantities in USD.
arrival_time str | list[str] Yes Arrival time(s). String format is: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'. e.g. '2024-01-20T15:04:05'.
fields str | list[str] | None No None Field(s) to request.
forecast_model str | list[str] | None No None Forecast model(s). Possible values are "tradefeedr/Global", "tradefeedr/Fast", "tradefeedr/Slow".

Returns

pd.DataFrame

Example

import lseg.data as ld
ld.tradefeedr.get_fx_algo_pre_trade_forecast(
    universe=["EURUSD", "USDJPY"],
    order_quantity_usd=[50e6, 30e6],
    arrival_time=["2023-08-10 11:52", "2023-08-10 12:30"]
)
